transcript.statement: The safety and reliability of the RollCall system are paramount to ensure accurate attendance tracking and protect sensitive student data. SAF-01 guarantees secure authentication, while SAF-02 ensures real-time synchronization to avoid discrepancies. SAF-03 provides automated alerts for reporting errors, essential for maintaining data integrity. SAF-04 establishes a long-term data retention policy, and SAF-05 ensures modifications are logged for accountability. SAF-06 allows for manual overrides during failures, and SAF-07 ensures regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities. Together, these requirements create a safe and reliable system for users.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for the RollCall system to ensure seamless user experience and timely attendance tracking. EFF-01 and EFF-02 guarantee real-time processing and support for a large number of concurrent users, essential for classroom environments. EFF-03 ensures rapid report generation, supporting administrators in decision-making. EFF-04 and EFF-05 focus on historical data retention and quick access for students, which are key for transparency. EFF-06 optimizes resource usage across classes, while EFF-07 enhances user interaction. Together, these requirements ensure the system operates efficiently and responsively, catering to user needs without delays.

transcript.statement: The RollCall system must adhere to ethical standards and regulatory compliance to protect student data and ensure accountability. RES-01 ensures compliance with data protection regulations like GDPR, vital for legal adherence. RES-02 promotes transparency in attendance recording, fostering trust among users. RES-03 provides students with a fair process to dispute attendance records, ensuring accountability. RES-04 protects student identities in reports, vital for fairness. RES-05 ensures timely notification of attendance status, promoting social responsibility. RES-06 emphasizes role-based access control to safeguard data. RES-07 aligns with educational regulations for historical data retention, reinforcing compliance and responsibility.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is essential for the RollCall system to minimize its environmental impact. GRN-01 ensures energy-efficient data processing, crucial for reducing the carbon footprint. GRN-02 promotes the use of eco-friendly cloud storage solutions, which helps in resource management. GRN-03 allows for low-energy attendance updates, enhancing overall efficiency. GRN-04 ensures reports are generated with minimal digital resource usage, while GRN-05 raises awareness of users' carbon footprints. GRN-06 aligns data retention policies with sustainable practices, and GRN-07 optimizes the user interface for low-power devices, contributing to energy conservation. Together, these requirements foster a responsible approach to technology.

transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is essential for the RollCall system to ensure the security and privacy of student attendance data. TRU-01 guarantees encryption for data at rest and in transit, safeguarding sensitive information. TRU-02 implements role-based access control, ensuring that only authorized personnel can access data. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for all access and modifications, promoting accountability. TRU-04 ensures that students can only view their records after authentication, protecting their privacy. TRU-05 verifies data integrity through checksums, while TRU-06 allows users to report breaches, enhancing security. TRU-07 enforces session timeouts, further safeguarding user data.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure real-time attendance updates within 2 seconds while optimizing security protocols to minimize resource conflicts.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation while maintaining secure access control.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of 5 years, aligning with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds after successful authentication.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms that optimize performance without compromising security or user experience.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second to enhance user experience.
The system shall provide automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours.
